### Satan Crushed Under Our Feet
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/satan-crushed-under-our-feet
Passage: Romans 16:20
Points:
- The promise that God will crush Satan echoes Genesis 3:15 and guarantees the ultimate defeat of the devil and his followers.
- Christ has already decisively broken the power of evil through His death and resurrection.
- Given alongside warnings about false teachers, this promise comforts the church that division and deception will not prevail.
- Even with victory assured, believers are called to remain vigilant and rely entirely on God's sustaining grace.
